rv.q: When the two women are “enjoying” one of their slanging matches, there is an undeniable frisson. Nuance is lent by directorial flashes from Emma Baggott, notably with musical punctuation from Nishla Smith reminding us we’re in a dirty old town and a moving metal structure designed by Peter Butler that threatens to collapse like the lives above...
Vivid and affecting revival of Shelagh Delaney’s groundbreaking play
